{{Quote|It is a one-of-a-kind gem as large as your fist, mined from the depths of Sullust millennia ago. We revere it.|Miel Muwn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Murustavan Ruby''' was a priceless, unique gem revered as an artifact on the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. It was approximately the size of a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan's]] fist and was valuable not only for its size, but for its age. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the gem was already millennia old.

The gem was stolen by the notorious criminal [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]], who intended to deliver a fake version of the gem to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kasstroff]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Sith]], but was thwarted by the combined efforts of [[Miel Muwn]], a peace officer with the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]], and Skavak's nemesis, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who would later come to be known as the [[Voidhound]].
